# ROBOTA1

> ROBOTA1 is the robotic-hub brand of Assurich Industries Pte Ltd (Singapore): industrial robots, AGV/AMR logistics, vacuum lifting, palletizing, service and cleaning robots and robot coffee stations, supplied and supported across ASEAN. Request a quote at https://robota1.com/#/contact or sales@assurich.com, +65 64591069.

## Product categories
- [Robot Welding](https://robota1.com/category/welding-robots/): Welding robots and welding cobots; 5 models
- [Industrial Robotic Arms](https://robota1.com/category/industrial-robots/): Industrial robotic arms; 6 models
- [Logistics & Material Handling](https://robota1.com/category/logistics/): AGV, vacuum lifting and palletizing systems; 28 models
- [Service & Cleaning Robots](https://robota1.com/category/service-cleaning-robots/): Service and cleaning robots; 5 models
- [Robot Station Service](https://robota1.com/category/robot-stations/): Robot station services (robot coffee stations); 3 models

## Featured models
- [iiMT CI-05Wy](https://robota1.com/products/iimt-ci-05wy/): portable collaborative welding robot with magnetic base, 5 kg payload, 900 mm reach
- [iiMT CI series](https://robota1.com/products/iimt-ci-series/): collaborative robots, 3-20 kg payload, 600-1,650 mm reach
